description: Circle of Dreams Druids draw power from the dreaming realm, using illusion and healing magic.

features.name: Dream Mending
features.description: When you cast a spell that restores hit points, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the amount restored.

features.name: Reverie Ward
features.description: You and nearby allies gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier at the start of your turn.

features.name: Dream Step
features.description: As a reaction, you can teleport up to 60 feet when you or an ally within 30 feet takes damage.

features.name: Shared Dream
features.description: You can cast dream spells on a target within 30 feet without line of sight.
